Increased tendency to bleed
High vitamin E intakes are associated with an increased tendency to bleed and this was the symptom that the Food and Nutrition
Board used to set the UL. It is not known if increased bleeding is a result of decreased platelet aggregation caused by an inhibition
of protein kinase C by a-tocopherol, some other platelet related mechanism, or decreased clotting due to a vitamin K and E inter-
